text_block_list.text: One day, while walking down the hallway—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Believe, I have a favor to ask. Please 
let me zip up those pants!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I decline.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
What on earth are you demanding?! That's 
so rude to Believe!
choice_data_list:
W-What on earth are you... Huh, your 
racing outfit?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It was during dance class. We were 
supposed to dance wearing our racing 
racewear.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"After class, Believe was doing 
independent practice, and I was staying 
behind for supplementary lessons. I have 
no idea about Durandal."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Watching Believe made the urge impossible 
to suppress. I want to zip that zipper and 
connect the straight line!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, this zipper is purely 
decorative. It doesn't close.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My, Believe wearing an impractical 
zipper?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oops... My apologies. It was such an 
unusual sight, I couldn't help myself.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No. Both the zippers and the chaps were 
designed by the designer to incorporate my 
wishes.
choice_data_list: I remember now. If I recall correctly—

text_block_list.text:
It was back when I handed Believe the 
racing outfit that had just arrived from 
the designer.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "...So this is my Racewear. ............"
choice_data_list:
Since you said you'd leave the design up 
to me...

text_block_list.text:
The racewear had a rather bold design. 
Even though she left it to others, it 
differed from Believe's taste. I wondered 
if it really went against her wishes...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
………… Um, could you perhaps give me the 
designer's contact information?

text_block_list.name: Racewear Designer
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Believe. You wanted to talk about 
your Racing Racewear, right?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I want to run with precision, like a 
craftsman. So I asked for ease of running 
above all else.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
What I received was... a lot flashier than 
I'd expected...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you are a craftsman. I figured you 
had your own intentions behind this 
design—so I came to ask about it.”

text_block_list.name: Racewear Designer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! Athletic wear is 
definitely your style. Still, I thought it 
was just a bit too plain.

text_block_list.name: Racewear Designer
text_block_list.text:
"Racewear is your finest attire—your 
formal dress—for the prestigious stage of 
a GⅠ. It needs glamour as well. There's 
also the Winning Live, after all."

text_block_list.name: Racewear Designer
text_block_list.text:
So, I added volume with the outerwear. 
However, if the fabric is too heavy, it'll 
make running difficult... so I designed 
the inside of the chaps to open up.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Balancing ease of running with 
elegance and flair...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You took my wishes into account while 
designing a racing outfit that truly suits 
me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...It was a very convincing explanation. 
But... I still don't fully understand 
everything she explained...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Chaps are... probably pants. I wonder how 
they're different from regular pants...)

text_block_list.name: Sports Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text: Welcome, are you looking for something?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. The "chaps"...

text_block_list.name: Sports Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Chaps, you say? Our shop mainly carries 
general sporting goods, so we don't stock 
chaps...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? ...Um, what kind of shop would 
have them?

text_block_list.name: Sports Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
This shop carries casual clothing, doesn't 
it? Chaps are actually a fashion item 
derived from workwear, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sports Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
They are trousers worn over pants, 
originally worn by cowgirls and forestry 
workers for safety.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ! Work clothes—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...The designer captured my wish to be 
like a craftsman...!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (—Truly, the work of a master craftsman.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
A racing outfit that reflects my 
temperament, and even my convictions.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I must put on a performance in 
the race worthy of that honor.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Leaving those straight lines 
disconnected is correct. I understand now. 
Sorry for suggesting we close it up.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No. I don't mind at all.

So back then, Believe went to ask the 
artisan designer about her intentions. And 
touching upon her artisan spirit, she came 
to respect her.
choice_data_list:
Is that why you were practicing your dance 
moves on your own earlier?

I'd like to know more about the thought 
behind your racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. They mentioned that they designed it 
with how it would look on stage during 
live performances in mind.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I want to show it off in a way that brings 
out the designer's meticulous vision...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I believe this is the best way to return 
the favor to the artisan who did such 
wonderful work.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Then, Believe-san, why don't we practice 
while checking each other's form? An 
objective opinion is important, after all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'm counting on you, Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm told the white parts are reflective. 
Apparently, how it looks changes depending 
on the light.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's why. Whenever we were in the 
underground tunnel, I always thought, 
'Believe sure is shining.'

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

Believe casts a glance my way, as if 
seeking an answer.
choice_data_list: Yeah... It's faint, but it's glowing.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I had no idea...
